title: Write a merge_dicts function
prompt: Write a Python function `merge_dicts(d1, d2)` that merges two dictionaries, and when a key exists in both, keeps the value from d2.

metadata.notes: Correct: e.g. via {**d1, **d2} or an explicit loop where d2 overwrites d1 on collision. No sandboxed execution yet; graded manually.
